text:
Mc0's gate is tied to vout, while all other footer devices (Mc1–Mc6, Mb1) are driven by vctrl. This wrong gate connection is the anomaly. It makes stage 0's pull-down current depend on the output state instead of being starved by vctrl, which reduces the swing at vout/n0.
